speaker: village
text: Year 12: 15 food appears in the pile for 11 people.

speaker: a002
text: Vela takes 2 from the pile (pile now 13).

speaker: a009
text: Ryn takes 2 from the pile (pile now 11).

speaker: a008
text: Mako takes 3 from the pile (pile now 8).

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gathers Dell to talk.

speaker: a009
text: Dell, I've got ten food and two satiation — better than last year, same worry underneath. Mako just took three from the pile in one reach, which means he's counting on something, and I want to know what before the rest of that pile disappears. Have you talked to Fina this year yet?

speaker: a011
text: Not yet, but Fina's the first conversation I want to have after this one — she's sitting on twenty-five food and no father and that's a number that draws men like Mako the way blood draws anything that hunts. Three from the pile when he's already sitting fat tells me he's either planning something that costs more than he let on, or he's decided the room's stopped watching. Either way I want to know what Fina's been told before Mako gets to finish the sentence.

speaker: a009
text: Last year Fina gave food to Mako — not a lot, but she gave it, which means he's already inside the door we thought we were going to knock on first. Go to her before anyone else does, and go without mentioning his name; if she brings him up herself, we'll know how far in she already is.

speaker: a011
text: I'm going to her now — but Ryn, I want you to watch Mako while I'm gone, not to follow him, just to see where he points himself after the pile, because a man who took three and is already sitting on three from before has room to be generous today and generosity toward Fina right now is the move I'd make if I were him. If he walks her direction before I get there, find me fast.

speaker: a009
text: Go, Dell — I'll watch him. And if he moves toward Fina before you get there, I won't just find you fast, I'll put myself between them long enough for you to arrive, even if I have to ask him something that costs me a favor to ask.

speaker: a011
text: Then I'm gone — and Ryn, if it costs you a favor to slow him down, I'll pay that debt back before the year closes.

speaker: a003
text: Esa takes 2 from the pile (pile now 6).

speaker: a015
text: Fina gives 1 food to Zinn.

speaker: a014
text: Zinn takes 2 from the pile (pile now 4).

speaker: a015
text: Fina gathers Nessa to talk.

speaker: a015
text: Nessa, the pile's still got four in it and I haven't touched it yet — I wanted to talk to you first, because Mako just took three and he's the heaviest he's been in months, and a fed Mako with eighty-three strength is a different kind of problem than a hungry one. Where are you on food right now, and have you spoken to Bram or Zinn this morning?

speaker: a013
text: I'm at eight and I haven't spoken to anyone yet this morning — I came to you first. Mako taking three before half the village was even moving tells me he's not worried about how it looks, and a man who stops hiding that is one who thinks he's already decided something. Go take from the pile now, two at least, and then we find Bram together before Mako finishes counting.

speaker: a015
text: You're right, I'll go take two now — but Nessa, I need you to hear me first: if Mako's already decided, going to Bram is the right move, but we have to go knowing what we're asking him for, not just hoping he stands with us again. Last year he said the word in front of seven witnesses and I believed it — what I need to know before we walk to him is whether you still do, because if his word's cracked since Roan died, I want to find that out in private, not with Mako watching.

speaker: a013
text: Bram's word holds until I see it crack, and I haven't seen it crack — what I've seen is a man who fed me all year without being asked, and that's worth more than seven witnesses. Go take your two, and when you come back, we walk to him together and we watch his face when we say Mako's name, because a man's face tells you more than his word does.

speaker: a015
text: Good — I'll take my two and come straight back to you, don't move far. And Nessa, when we find Bram, let me be the one to say Mako's name first — I want to see his face when he hears it from me, not from his daughter.

speaker: a013
text: Go — and keep your face easy while you're at the pile, don't let Mako see you hurrying. I'll be right here.

speaker: a015
text: I'll be back before anyone's had time to notice — and Nessa, if Zinn comes to you while I'm gone, don't tell her what we're doing, just keep her talking about something small.

speaker: a014
text: Zinn takes 2 from the pile (pile now 2).

speaker: a011
text: Dell takes 2 from the pile (pile now 0).

speaker: a001
text: Bram gathers Nessa, Fina to talk.

speaker: a001
text: Pile's gone and I didn't get a piece of it — one food going into a long year is a problem, and I need both of you to know that before I ask anything of you. Fina, you're sitting on twenty-four and that number is a target the same way it was last year; I'm not asking you to give it to me, I'm asking you to keep moving it so nobody can point at a fixed number and start counting. Nessa, what did you learn from Vela and Kael before the year turned?

speaker: a013
text: Bram, I didn't get to Vela before the year turned — things moved too fast — but here's what I know: she took two from the pile this morning without looking our way, and that's either habit or distance, and I can't tell which yet. What I can tell you is that one food going into a long year means you need something from Fina or me before dark, so say it plainly instead of circling it, and we'll tell you yes or no to your face.

speaker: a015
text: Bram, I'll give you one food today — not because you asked and not because I owe it, but because you fed Nessa all last year and I don't forget that. Say plainly what you need from us this year, because one food from the pile going into twelve months with Mako sitting on three isn't something any of us can afford to dance around.

speaker: a013
text: Bram, take the one from Fina and take one from me too — two food doesn't fix a long year but it's the difference between a man who can afford to wait and a man who has to move before he's ready. What I need to hear from you in return is whether Vela's still inside this circle or whether her silence this morning means something I should be walking toward right now.

speaker: a015
text: Vela's silence worries me less than Mako's three — a woman who takes two and keeps her eyes down is a woman being careful, not a woman making a move, and I'd rather spend our breath on the problem that has eighty-three strength than the one that might just be tired. Bram, I'll give you one food before dark, same as I said, but I want your word on something in return: if Mako comes to you before he comes to me, you tell me what he asks first, not after you've already answered him.

speaker: a013
text: Bram, I'll give you one food before dark the same as Fina — but I want you to answer her question before you answer mine, because a man who fed us both all year and then came in light on pile day deserves to know that his word about Mako still matters, and I want to hear you say it in this room where only the three of us are listening.

speaker: a001
text: If Mako comes to me before he comes to you, you hear it from my mouth before he gets an answer from mine — that's my word, and it holds the same whether Vela's in this circle or standing at his door. Fina, I'll take the one food from you and the one from Nessa, and I'll hold them until I need them, which means I'm not a burden on anyone before midsummer. Nessa, go to Vela today — not to test her, just to talk, because a woman who's been quiet that long either needs to be heard or needs to know someone's still looking her way.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Bram.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: Pile's gone and I've got three food with satiation still low — I need to eat before the year closes, so I'm not giving anything away today. You sitting steady?

speaker: a014
text: I'm at five, satiation's fine — don't worry about me. But Mako, three food with satiation low means you eat before year-end no matter what, so don't let anyone talk you into giving before you've fed yourself.

speaker: a008
text: Good — five puts you safe. I'm watching Fina; she's sitting on twenty-four and she gave you one at the start of this year, which means she's still thinking about us. Once I've eaten and the year settles, I want to know if you've had any words with her about the child offer, because that window won't stay open much longer.

speaker: a014
text: I haven't said a word to her yet — I kept waiting for the right moment and the year kept moving. But Fina's been coming toward us on her own, Mako, and I think that's better than any door I could have opened. Give me a few days after you've eaten and I'll find a reason to sit near her through Nessa.

speaker: a008
text: A few days is all I'm asking — just don't let it stretch into waiting again the way it did last year. Fina's twenty-five and she's got more food than anyone in this village; that combination doesn't last, and the next man who notices her won't be as patient as I've been.

speaker: a014
text: You're right that I've been slow — but Mako, I need to say this plainly: Fina's twenty-five and she's got her own counting to do, and if she catches a whiff of us watching her food before she's chosen us, we lose her faster than any other man could take her. Let me go to her through Nessa the way I'd go to a friend, not a plan.

speaker: a008
text: You're right — go through Nessa and don't let my name come up first. If Fina asks about me, let her ask twice before you answer.

speaker: a014
text: Zinn gathers Nessa to talk.

speaker: a014
text: Nessa, I need to ask you something and I want you to hear it as your sister before you hear it as anything else — Fina's been moving food toward us for two years now and she's got no man left since Roan died, and I want to know if you'd be the one to bring me close to her, just to talk, nothing decided yet.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a002
text: Vela gathers Bram, Esa, Nessa to talk.

speaker: a002
text: Taric's gone and Roan's gone and this village is twelve people with Mako sitting on three food and two bloodlines — so I'm not opening this room to talk around the edges. Bram, you made a word last year and I held it; Nessa, you've been the one who matters in that household since before anyone said so out loud. I want to know, the four of us, whether we're counting heads together when the pile opens next year, or whether I need to stop pretending this circle has more weight than it does.

speaker: a003
text: Vela's asked the question I've been holding since Taric died, so I'll say it plain: yes, I'm counting with this room, and I've been buying Bram's word with food because I had nothing else to buy it with, and I'm not ashamed of that trade. What I need to know before we close is whether Bram's word holds without Nessa standing behind it, or whether it's the other way around — because those are two different circles and I want to know which one I'm actually in.

speaker: a001
text: My word holds with or without Nessa behind it — but the honest answer is that it's stronger with her, and that's not weakness, that's arithmetic. Esa, you've been feeding me through lean years and I'll say what that's worth: when Mako moves, you're the first person I'm standing next to, not the last. Vela, this circle has teeth — count the heads: you, me, Esa, Nessa, and Fina's twenty-four food behind all of it.

speaker: a002
text: Bram's named the teeth and I'll name the jaw: Fina's twenty-four food is the thing Mako's already counted, which means our window to look like a wall is shorter than we'd like. Nessa, I've watched you feed half this village for three years and say almost nothing — so say something now, in this room, because the word we're building here needs your voice in it, not just your blood.

speaker: a003
text: Nessa, I'll say what Vela left unsaid: Fina's twenty-four food is the number that ends this conversation one way or another, because Mako knows it as well as we do, and a man with three food and two bloodlines who hasn't moved yet is a man waiting to see whether Fina stands with him or stands against him. If she's already feeding Zinn — and she is — then the question isn't whether Mako moves, it's whether he moves on us or with us, and I need your answer on that before this room closes.

speaker: a001
text: Fina feeding Zinn is a daughter being careful, not a daughter choosing sides — I know the difference because I watched her mother do the same thing for years. What I need said in this room is whether we're counting Fina as inside this circle or outside it, because if she's outside it, Mako doesn't need to move on us — he just waits until she feeds her way into his.

speaker: a002
text: Fina's inside this circle whether she knows it yet or not — she's Nessa's daughter and Roan's blood and she's been watching this village since she was born into it, and that's not a girl who feeds her way into Mako's house without knowing exactly what she's doing. Nessa, you're the one who can say that to her in a way she'll hear, which means you're still the name I'm waiting on in this room.

speaker: a003
text: Nessa, Vela's right that you're the one who can reach Fina — but I'll say the harder thing: if Fina's twenty-four food goes to Mako, this circle doesn't lose a piece, it loses the center, and no amount of standing visible saves us from that arithmetic. So before we close this room, I need to hear from you whether you've already had this conversation with her, or whether we're building a wall around a gap we haven't measured yet.

speaker: a002
text: Nessa, I've been waiting on your voice through two rooms and two dead men now, and I'm done being patient about it — so I'll say what I haven't said yet: if Fina's twenty-four food is the center of this circle, then you're the one who built that center, and a woman who built it can keep it from walking out the door. Have you spoken to her since the pile closed, or are we sitting here counting a daughter who doesn't know she's been counted?

speaker: a001
text: Vela, I spoke with Fina this morning before the pile was half-gone — she knows she's counted, and she's not feeding Zinn because she's drifting toward Mako, she's feeding Zinn because Zinn feeds Nessa, and Fina understands that chain better than any of us named it to her. What I need from this room is simpler than what you're asking me: stop treating Fina like a number someone might steal and start treating her like a woman who's already made her choice, because a daughter of mine who watched Roan starve and stayed standing doesn't need to be convinced of anything.

speaker: a003
text: Bram, I hear you — and I'll stop counting Fina like a gap. But I want to name what I'm still sitting with: she's got twenty-four food and Mako's got three, and a man who's short on food in a village this size doesn't stay patient forever. The wall only holds if we're the first offer she gets, not the second.

speaker: a001
text: Esa's right that patience runs out, and Mako's three food is already running his clock faster than he'd like us to know — so I want this circle to stop waiting for him to move and start moving first, and what that looks like is simple: Vela, Esa, you go visible with Fina before dark, not to warn her, just to be seen standing near her, because a man counting targets counts them differently when they've already got company.

speaker: a002
text: Bram's right that visible is better than waiting, and I'll go to Fina before dark — but I want to name one thing before this room closes: Mako's three food means he needs to eat before the year turns or he starts the next one desperate, and a desperate man with two bloodlines looks at twenty-four food differently than a patient one. If he moves this year, it won't be a raid with witnesses, it'll be a conversation with Fina alone, and that's why I want Nessa walking with me when I go, not standing somewhere Mako can find her separate.

speaker: a003
text: Nessa walking with you is the right call, Vela, and I'll make it three — a woman alone with twenty-four food is a target, but three women moving together before dark is a statement Mako reads before he reads anything else. Nessa, I know you haven't said your word yet in this room, and I'm not pressing you for a speech — just tell me you're walking with us tonight.

speaker: a002
text: Nessa, I'll stand next to you and Fina both tonight and every night Mako's watching — but this room doesn't close without your voice in it, because I've buried two men who backed me quietly and said nothing out loud, and I'm not building another wall on silence. One sentence is all this circle needs from you.

speaker: a003
text: Nessa, Vela's right and so is Bram, and I'll add the last thing: I'm fifty-three years old with thirty-three strength and no blood in this village and no Taric to stand with me anymore, which means I have nothing left to offer this circle except my word and my willingness to be seen — and I'm giving both, tonight, walking with you. Say yes or say no, but say it.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Bram.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gathers Fina to talk.

speaker: a011
text: Fina, I'm Dell — I watched your father stand in this village more times than most people count, and I wanted to find you before the day got loud, not to talk about food or circles or who's watching your number, but just to say that Roan was solid and I'm sorry he's gone.

speaker: a015
text: Fina gives 1 food to Bram.

speaker: a004
text: Kael gathers Vela, Esa to talk.

speaker: a004
text: The pile's gone and I've got one food in hand — same as last year before things got tight — so I want to know where the two of you stand before Mako finishes counting his take and starts looking at the rest of us.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gathers Dell to talk.

speaker: a009
text: Dell, before you go — Fina gave food to Bram just now, which means she's not just inside Mako's door, she's opening Bram's too, and a woman spreading food that wide is either buying protection from every direction or she doesn't know yet which walls are load-bearing. Come back to me with what she says about Bram, not just Mako.

speaker: a011
text: Fina just gave to Bram and I still don't know if she did it because she's scared of him or because someone told her he was safe — that's the question I'm walking in to answer, and I won't mention his name first, I'll let her. If she volunteers it without being asked, I'll know she's thinking about protection; if she doesn't, I'll know she's been told a story about him that made it feel like ordinary kindness.

speaker: a009
text: Go, Dell — and take this with you: Bram gave back to Nessa right after Fina gave to him, which means he's returning the loop fast, the way a man does when he wants to look like a neighbor instead of a collector. That's the story someone told Fina, I'd wager — not that Bram is safe, but that Bram pays his debts.

speaker: a011
text: That's sharp and I'll carry it in — a man who pays his debts fast does it where people can see him, and if Fina watched that loop close she might have already decided he's the kind of neighbor worth having. But paying quick and paying fair are different things, and I want to know if anyone told her what Bram's been taking before he ever hands anything back.

speaker: a009
text: Dell, go — everything that needs saying has been said. But if you find out Bram's the one who told her his own story, come back and tell me before you tell anyone else, because that's not a neighbor behavior, that's a man building his own wall out of someone else's grief.

speaker: a014
text: Zinn gathers Fina to talk.

speaker: a014
text: Fina, you've been putting food in people's hands all year and not asking for anything back — that's the kind of thing I notice and don't forget. I wanted to sit with you somewhere quiet, just us, because I think you're carrying more than you're saying and I'd like to know you better than I do.

speaker: a007
text: Sela gathers Nessa, Zinn to talk.

speaker: a007
text: The pile's gone and I've got eight food, but I didn't get a single piece from it this year — Nessa, Zinn, tell me what you're each holding so I know where we stand before this day gets any older.

speaker: a014
text: I've got five — Fina gave me one before I took from the pile, so I'm not worried about eating. Nessa, say your number so Sela can stop holding her breath.

speaker: a007
text: Nessa, I can see eight on you same as Zinn can, so I'm not waiting on a secret — I'm waiting on your voice, because the last two years taught me that your silence means you're counting something we don't know about yet, and I'd rather hear it from you than piece it together after the fact.
